title: The Clever Fox
text:
Once there was a little fox. He lived in a big forest. The fox was very clever. He liked to help his friends.

One day, a hungry wolf wanted to eat the fox. But the fox had a plan. He said, 'Look at the big river. There is a big fish in it!' The wolf ran to the river. The fox was safe.

questions.text: What did the wolf want to eat?
Why did the fox say that there was a big fish in the river?
options: He wanted the wolf to go away from him
He wanted to swim in the river
He wanted to make a new friend

questions.text: How do you think the fox feels at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: able to think quickly and solve problems
a large area with many trees
an idea about how to do something

paragraph_translations: Колись жив маленький лис. Він жив у великому лісі. Лис був дуже розумним. Він любив допомагати своїм друзям.
Одного дня голодний вовк хотів з'їсти лиса. Але в лиса був план. Він сказав: «Подивіться на велику річку. У ній є велика риба!» Вовк побіг до річки. Лис був у безпеці.
